integrity: The result is a direct mathematical derivation. The included checker performs finite consistency tests, which do not prove limiting distributions. Literature priority is subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Independent iid switching, a fixed deterministic initial state approaching the neutral point, and fixed positive parameters. No stationary or quenched return-time law and no higher centered subcritical fluctuation law are established.
title: Gaussian first-exit crossover for randomly switched intermittent maps
